description: This file defines a SocketConnection class for managing WebSocket-like communication over TCP, including message handling, version comparison, and error logging.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: Manages socket communication, message dispatching, and buffer handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message object over the socket, serialized as JSON.

methods.name: _onData
methods.description: Handles incoming data buffers, extracts complete messages separated by newlines, and dispatches them.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Parses a message string and invokes the onmessage callback.
